name: Ring and orbit arc
what: On black, a huge glowing ring shrinks onto a centre title that is typed in letter by letter, then rises to the top; below it a coloured arc draws from a dot on the left round to a dot on the right while two more texts are typed along it.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f8: a ring bigger than the frame fades in and shrinks (36 px a frame to f22, then decelerating to f46) onto the middle; letters of the centre text are typed every 10 f from f19; f36-f52 the ring rises to the upper middle; f28-f42 a dot fades in at the left and f41-f78 an arc draws round below the ring (decelerating) to a second dot (f76-f84); two texts are typed along it, a letter every 3 f, from f48 (left) and f66 (right); it holds to f148.
